answer: The strongest lever is simple: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because ripple only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
